subject: Temporary telemetry subcontractor authorization request
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@edgeflux.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-10T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Temporary telemetry subcontractor (Observa Labs) — scope and timeline

Hi Rachel,

Quick note from EdgeFlux: we need to onboard a short-lived telemetry subcontractor (Observa Labs) to help with a limited cache/telemetry shard for the upcoming Northbridge pilot (3-week window). This is a temporal addition — no data retention beyond 30 days and only aggregated telemetry is shared.

Can you confirm if a DPA addendum + DocuSign approval from procurement is sufficient, or do you need SOC2 evidence + granular subprocessor CSV? We can push both today if that helps accelerate the pilot.

High-level:
- Purpose: temporary telemetry caching + metric enrichment
- Data: aggregated telemetry, no PII, sampling at 0.1
- Residency: US region (no cross-border)
- Retention: 30 days (auto-delete)
- Access controls: RBAC, encrypted at rest (AES-256)

If you prefer, Matt from Observa CC'd can provide the substantiating artifacts and a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships — EdgeFlux
--Attachment: none attached in this initial ping
From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@edgeflux.io>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-10T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary telemetry subcontractor (Observa Labs) — scope and timeline

Elena — thanks for the heads up. A few quick asks so we can sign off internally: 

1) Please share a machine-readable subprocessor roster (CSV) listing exact subprocessors, country of processing, and data types processed.
2) SOC2 summary (or equivalent) covering Logging/Monitoring and Change Management; redacted artifacts are fine initially.
3) DocuSign addendum that references the Redwood DPA and limits the scope to the pilot (dates + auto-delete clause).
4) Confirmation that no tenant-level logs or request bodies will be shared — only aggregated counters.

I'll route this to procurement and security once we have the CSV + SOC2 summary. Marking a target turnaround of EOD Friday (2027-11-12) to make the pilot window. CC'ing Markus and Lauren for procurement/legal intake routing.

Also, Kim (security) — please advise on whether we need an onshore fallback clause beyond the stated US residency.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Rachel / team — thanks. A couple of items from Legal/Procurement perspective:

- Lauren: can you triage the DocuSign workflow and confirm who in procurement needs to sign? If Northbridge procurement must countersign, we should include that field in the DocuSign (procurement@northbridgebank.com).
- Kimberly: from InfoSec, if Observa's processing is limited to aggregated telemetry and retention is enforced automatically, a SOC2 summary + encryption attest should suffice; however, we should require an immediate removal SLA (48 hours) in case of incident, plus an audit access clause limited to scope. Please advise if we need a scoped onshore fallback.

I'll hold on the greenlight until the CSV + SOC2 summary arrive. If they can't meet EOD Friday, propose we push the pilot start by one week.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Enterprise Sales (EMEA & NA) — Redwood Inference

Subject: Observa Labs artifacts + DocuSign for Redwood addendum

Hi Rachel / Markus / Lauren — attaching the requested materials. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Attachments (attached):
- observalabs_subprocessors.csv (CSV) — lists Observa, our cloud CDN partner, and a managed metrics store; includes country column
- observalabs_soc2-summary.pdf (PDF) — redacted SOC2 Type II summary covering security and change mgmt (last audit: 2027-06)
- observalabs_docusign-addendum.url (link) — DocuSign envelope prepared to add Observa as a limited-scope subprocessor under Redwood's DPA (expires 2027-11-25)

DocuSign envelope notes: the addendum limits processing to aggregated telemetry, retention 30 days, automatic deletion clause, and an emergency removal SLA (48 hours). We've included procurement@northbridgebank.com as an additional counter-sign field per Lauren's note.

Drive link to full evidence folder (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-observalabs-evidence
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/example/observalabs-addendum-12345

On the CSV: Observa does use a third-party metrics ingest CDN in the US (EdgeStream). EdgeStream is listed and is US-only; no EU transfers. If you need EdgeStream's SOC summary, we can pull that as well but it will take 24 hours.

Let us know if the redacted SOC2 + CSV are enough to proceed.

Thanks,
Matt Carter
Head of Security Operations — Observa Labs

Matt / Elena — received, thanks for the fast turnaround and for including the DocuSign envelope. Next steps on our side: 

1) Procurement (Lauren) will review DocuSign and route for countersign with Northbridge procurement. Lauren — please confirm target sign-off date.
2) Security (Kimberly) — if EdgeStream evidence is required, let us know; otherwise the redacted SOC2 + CSV meets our immediate intake for a limited pilot.
3) I will sign the DPA addendum from Redwood (once countersigned by Northbridge) and confirm pilot start date and scope in a follow-up.

Checklist for Observa before we go live (please confirm in a reply):
- Confirm automated 30-day retention enforcement is enabled and auditable.
- Confirmation that no request/response payloads or tenant-specific logs will be captured or stored.
- Emergency removal procedure (48 hours) documented and contact for escalation.

If all above are confirmed and procurement signs the DocuSign envelope, we will consider the pilot approved. Targeting internal sign-off by 2027-11-17 EOD.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
